notes: This portable scenario calls the official RTIambassador automatic-resign getter/setter for all six ResignAction enumerators listed by the IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API, verifies each accepted value through the getter, and checks InvalidResignAction for the next value outside that enumerator set. The test restores NO_ACTION before resigning so object or ownership cleanup is not part of its oracle. It uses only the official IEEE C++ API and standard library.
